# Spacing and size

Space, radius, stroke and size steps, from the raw scale to what a page, a card or a control reads.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/TokensSpacingAndSize.mdx`

## Overview

Every gap, pad, radius and size is a step on one scale. Global tokens are shared steps; Components holds what a card, modal, Popup, table or single component needs; Templates holds the Page, Section and Frame, which size a whole screen.
